tests.title: Accept every valid symbolic address vector
tests.requirement: Resource and binding addresses are deterministically parseable.

tests.title: Reject every invalid symbolic address vector
tests.requirement: Malformed or ambiguous symbolic addresses are rejected.

tests.title: Accept all canonical descriptor and representation schemas
tests.requirement: Published schemas are valid JSON Schema 2020-12 documents.

tests.title: Accept the canonical descriptor catalog
tests.requirement: Core descriptors validate against their schemas and integrity rules.

tests.title: Reject structural similarity as semantic identity
tests.requirement: Structural compatibility does not imply semantic compatibility.

tests.title: Reject a missing required Representation Binding
tests.requirement: Referenced Representation Bindings resolve explicitly.

tests.title: Reject an incompatible Processor edge
tests.requirement: Route compatibility is nominal and explicit.

tests.title: Reject an unknown required extension
tests.requirement: Unknown required extensions cause explicit incompatibility.

tests.title: Reject an unresolved ProcessorImplementation
tests.requirement: ProcessorImplementation identity resolves to its Processor Version.

tests.title: Reject unsupported required state
tests.requirement: A host fails closed when it cannot satisfy a required State Port.

tests.title: Reject a malformed Receipt chain
tests.requirement: Adjacent Receipt output and input digests link exactly.

tests.title: Reject a mutated immutable Contract Version
tests.requirement: One immutable Contract identity cannot select mutated content.

tests.title: Reject ambiguous Namespace identity
tests.requirement: A Namespace alias cannot silently select between immutable identities.

tests.title: Derive the canonical two-stage routes
tests.requirement: A Planner discovers transitive routes from declared Processor edges.

tests.title: Preserve an unknown optional extension
tests.requirement: Unknown optional extensions are ignorable and preservable.

tests.title: Reject an exact-byte artifact digest mismatch
tests.requirement: A referenced artifact with the wrong SHA-256 digest is rejected.

tests.title: Validate values at every selected Representation Binding
tests.requirement: Source, intermediate, and output values satisfy selected bindings.

tests.title: Execute the selected ProcessorImplementation
tests.requirement: The host invokes a compatible implementation while preserving Processor identity.

tests.title: Fail closed for unauthorized unsafe and open-world effects
tests.requirement: Unsupported or unauthorized effect requirements are not silently ignored.

tests.title: Return the same route for the same catalog and query
tests.requirement: Reference planning behavior is deterministic and inspectable.

tests.title: Emit a conforming Receipt for every executed stage
tests.requirement: Execution Receipts record semantic, implementation, and value identities.

tests.title: Link adjacent stage value digests
tests.requirement: A stage output digest equals the consuming stage input digest.
